newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm despite few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm despite few enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes held firm on Monday amid strength in the cargo market since late last week, traders said.

"It's usually quiet on Monday and enquiries are not healthy, but we can not lower offers or we will lose money," said one supplier, nothing the 180-cst fuel oil's traded level at $102.00 per tonne last week.

Bunker 180-cst was quoted by majors at $107/$108 and the 380-cst was at $100/$101. Some independents offered $2-$3 per tonne lower. MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $190/$193 and $205/$210 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
